name: Amanda Buller
residence: Sweetwater County (she wrote that she was born and raised in the county)
occupation: Law-enforcement officer; in an August 2026 Green River Star voter-guide statement she wrote that she has served about 13 years in the community as a patrol deputy, police officer, K-9 handler, SWAT operator, field training officer, and K-9 team leader
military: Military non-commissioned officer (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026, voter-guide statement; branch not named in that article)
background: Amanda Buller ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Sweetwater County sheriff. In a Green River Star voter-guide statement she wrote that she was born and raised in Sweetwater County, has dedicated nearly 13 years to law enforcement in the community, and has served as a patrol deputy, police officer, K-9 handler, SWAT operator, field training officer, K-9 team leader, and military non-commissioned officer. She lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary.
